verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Stream Access is documented as real-time decisioning: an HTTP POST is sent to your endpoint during authorization, and you return HTTP 200 with the approve/decline decision. That covers the core of the story. Nothing in the pack documents the network response-time budget or a timeout fallback you can configure, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented response-time budget, a configurable timeout/stand-in fallback behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
